observation.command:
docker run --rm postgis/postgis:17-3.5 sh -c '
printf "deb [ signed-by=/usr/local/share/keyrings/postgres.gpg.asc ] http://apt-archive.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/ bullseye-pgdg main 17\n" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list
echo "=== apt-get update ==="
apt-get update 2>&1 | grep -E "bullseye-pgdg|Err|W:|E:" | head
echo "=== apt-get install (simulate) ==="
apt-get -s install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql-17-pgrouting 2>&1 | grep -E "Inst|following|E:|W:" | head
'
